description: The contract of an operation of the delivery gate that needs no socket (build, perf): it reads the worktree and the tools of the machine, writes its outputs in the worktree and in a temporary directory of its own, and talks to no one. It cannot read the credentials of the user, and cannot write what judges it: the settings of Claude Code, the gate, its configuration, or the git directory where verdicts are kept. Variables: ${home} (the user's home), ${worktree}, ${tmp} (created for this operation, removed after it).
